claims.summary: Characteristic zero, n,m>=0: the space Pol_(<n) + (1+z)^(-3/2) Pol_(<m) has Wronskian a nonzero constant times (1+z)^(-m(3/2+n)), hence no Weierstrass points off z=-1.
claims.assessment: Working proof: reduction to n-th derivatives, which span (1+z)^(-3/2-n) Pol_(<m)(1+z) because the falling factorial (j-3/2)...(j-1/2-n) is nonzero.
claims.rationale: Shows two-class components of degenerations (one visible root, one cluster) carry no Weierstrass points.

claims.summary: Characteristic zero. In the caterpillar degeneration a_j=c_j eps^(j-1) of the separated pair space (generic c_j), if the internal multiscale cluster's Pluecker coordinate on columns {0..binom(N-1,2)-1} strictly minimizes the eps-valuation, the outer components carry no Weierstrass points off their branch values. At N=5 the inner annuli carry six-point rings (at scales about 4/3 and 8/3), so the caterpillar does not avoid necks.
claims.assessment: Conditional on the strict minimality condition (unproved; nonvanishing holds by the translation lemma); the cross block is proved by Schur-polynomial valuations. Exact Wronskian at N=5, eps=1e-6, 1e-8: 30 simple non-branch roots, none at scales 0 and 4.
claims.rationale: Tests the caterpillar lead: outer components empty given minimality, but inner annuli carry necks with split far pair and split cluster.

relationships: Comparison of the inner annuli with the separated neck.
